title: NIMHANS Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Various Community Nurse Posts
description: National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences (NIMHANS) has announced the official notification for 2026. 02 vacancies have been allotted for Community Nurse Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.Sc. Nursing can use this opportunity and attend the walk-in at the address mentioned in the official notification. Here we have mentioned more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for the NIMHANS Notificatio...
